wrap_up.comparison: The agent review team was much quick and able to provide more thorough analysis on the videos. I was more accurate and able to pick up on every event that occured, but that required a high level of attention that could be devoted to other tasks.
wrap_up.slowest: Navigation could be more intuitive. The first few reviews I had to get aligned with where different buttons and videos were located. After I was accustomed, the app worked smoothly.
wrap_up.wrong: The app did not make up any information. It did, however, make very conservative judgements that were not worrisome in reality.
